title: PrimeAgentOrchestrator: Memory-Primed Agent Spawning for Personal AI Infrastructure
abstract: arXiv:2608.20342v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding agents start each session with an empty context window, discarding accumulated knowledge from prior work. We present PrimeAgentOrchestrator (PAO), a system that spawns new instances of Claude Code -- Anthropic's terminal-based coding agent -- pre-loaded with relevant memories compiled from the user's existing personal databases. At spawn time, PAO queries two independently-operated memory backends in parallel (a PostgreSQL entity-observation database and a Cloudflare Worker semantic search index), fuses results using backend-specific retrieval strategies, and delivers the compiled briefing via filesystem injection that exploits the host agent's configuration auto-read behavior. PAO manages the full agent lifecycle including trust pre-seeding, readiness polling with error detection, and adaptive terminal text injection. translated_title: PrimeAgentOrchestrator：面向个人AI基础设施的记忆预载代理生成系统
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20342v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）编码代理每次会话开始时都使用空上下文窗口，丢弃了先前工作中积累的知识。我们提出了PrimeAgentOrchestrator（PAO），一个系统，它生成Claude Code（Anthropic的终端编码代理）的新实例，并预载从用户现有个人数据库编译的相关记忆。在生成时，PAO并行查询两个独立运行的记忆后端（一个PostgreSQL实体-观察数据库和一个Cloudflare Worker语义搜索索引），使用后端特定检索策略融合结果，并通过文件系统注入提供编译后的简报，利用宿主代理的配置自动读取行为。PAO管理完整的代理生命周期，包括信任预置、带错误检测的就绪轮询和自适应终端文本注入。我们报告了四个月的常规部署情况（2025年12月至2026年3月）。
tldr: 该系统通过预载用户个人数据库中的记忆来生成编码代理实例，解决LLM代理会话上下文丢失问题，并管理完整生命周期以提升个人AI基础设施效率。
en_tdlr: This system spawns coding agent instances pre-loaded with memories from user personal databases, addressing LLM agent context loss across sessions, and manages the full lifecycle to enhance personal AI infrastructure efficiency.
